The 2026 list was revised on June 1, 2026 (FedEx_Standard_List_Rates_2026_wayback-2026-10-22.pdf, cover 'Effective January 5, 2026 / Updated June 1, 2026'). base_rates.csv carries the January 2026 prices from the Oct-2025 XLSX capture; the June revision is not used.

FedEx publishes one table for FedEx Ground and FedEx Home Delivery (1-150 lb, same structure); fedex_home_delivery rows are a copy of the fedex_ground rows. The per-package residential surcharge that the table's note adds to Home Delivery is in surcharges.csv (condition residential), not in the base rate. Home Delivery is residential-only, FedEx Ground business-only.

The express tables also list FedEx Envelope (up to 8 oz) and FedEx Pak rows and FedEx First Overnight / 2Day A.M. columns; they are outside the six dashboard services and are skipped. In the 2023 PDF the first page of each zone ends at 49 lb and the second starts at 50 lb (2024: 50/51).
